notes: Elbow locked, palm facing your thigh: swing the straight arm forward and back like a pendulum, 3 times, fast. Same plane as a curl, no sideways motion.
Slow: 3 s up, 3 s down. Count out loud: 11 lifts. All full and strict.

Count out loud: 12 lifts. Lifts 6 and 11: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 3 and 8: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Put the dumbbell down and pick it up again, three times. Not a set.
Count out loud: 7 lifts. Lift 3: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 9 lifts. Lift 8: hold 2–3 s halfway up, then finish it. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 2, 4 and 5: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lifts 4, 5 and 8: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.
Alternate arms; count only the sensor arm's lifts. Count out loud: 6 lifts. All full and strict.
Shake out your arm and fiddle with the strap for about 15 s, without moving the band. Not a set.
Fast: as fast as you can while staying in control. Count out loud: 6 lifts. Lift 3: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. All other lifts: full and strict.
Walk around for about 15 s, arms natural. Not a set: the counter should say 0.

Count out loud: 15 lifts. Lifts 4 and 5: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 10 and 11: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Curl until you can't do one more full rep. Count full reps only and TYPE that count at the prompt (Enter would record 0).
Same pendulum swings: elbow locked, palm facing your thigh, forward and back only.
